page.overview:
Who is Aga?

Aga was a female human who served in the Galactic Empire.

During the Imperial Era, the Galactic Empire established the listening post on Konkiv. Commanded by an admiral, the base became a backwater assignment for the Imperials, with some considering it a punishment to be assigned there. Eventually, the Imperial command forgot about the base and by 2 BBY, the only contact they had with the greater Empire was an automated supply drop once a cycle. The garrison chose to desert, using the base to establish their own settlement outside the bureaucracies of the Empire. Aga was a part of the garrison and taught the children on the base.

At some point during 2 BBY, the settlement was encountered by the rebels Sabine Wren, Garazeb Orrelios, and the droids C1-10P ("Chopper") and AP-5, who had come to the base believing it to be abandoned. The rebels encountered the rogue DT-series sentry droid on their arrival at the base and encountered the garrison upon their entry. AP-5 informed the admiral commanding the base that the droid had entered the base. While bringing the rebels to the command center, the admiral popped into Aga's classroom to tell her to close and lock the door, fearing the droid.

Aga was a female human with white hair, blue eyes and light skin color. She wore a standard Imperial officer's uniform.
